notes.title: Small Update (V1.042)
notes.notes:
Not being able to get any new upgrades after lvl 14 made later loops less interesting. So you can now keep earning gold even after reaching maximum level. This should also make going through new zones more worthwile. Later zones sometimes felt grindy if your build was lacking damage, so i reduced health of some enemies.


[list]
[*] You can now keep earning gold even after reaching maximum level
[*] Increased gold earned when entering 4th loop portal by 2 (when below lvl 14)
[*] Bullet upgrades now add special attribute if weapon has less than 2 attributes (previously you only got special attribute if weapon didn't have any attributes)
[*] Reduced wizard health from 60 to 55
[*] Reduced ghost health from 60 to 55
[*] Reduced spider health from 85 to 80
[*] Reduced eskimo health from 70 to 65
[*] Reduced penguin health from 80 to 75
[*] Reduced yeti health from 110 to 100
[*] Reduced magmablob health from 110 to 100
[*] Reduced knight health from 120 to 110
[*] Reduced dragon health from 140 to 130
[/list]

[b]Hotfix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed game freezing if you owned every tier 2 upgrade
[*] You are  no longer guaranteed to get tier 2 upgrades after lvl 14
[*] Increased magic spheres damage scaling
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update (V1.041)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed steam community screenshots not working (Screenshots can be taken with F12)
[*] Arena bonuses can now appear on multiple items in shop (Previously only 1 item could have arena bonus)
[*] Fixed magic staff ammo cost being too low
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update (V1.040)
notes.notes:
While doing some testing i noticed one more bug so i decided to do quick follow up update. I thought that i might as well give small buff for some of the weaker items. Cockroach felt by far the worst defensive item so i did small rework for it.

[list]
[*] Fixed arena bonuses not working with Strange Guns
[*] Cockroach now gives 20% damage bonus while at 1 health
[*] Increased Suspicious Mushroom attackspeed from 10-100% to 20-100%
[*] Increased Reload Gloves reload speed from 10-20% to 15-25% (It was actually weaker than intended)
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update (V1.039)
notes.notes:
Arenas felt somewhat grindy with so many enemies. There was also lot of idle waiting time in earlier arenas, since enemies died so fast. Arenas should now feel lot more fast paced with lower respawn times and reduced number enemies.


[list]
[*] Reduced number of enemies in arenas from 24 to 18
[*] Reduced starting respawn time from 10 to 6.6 - 9.6 seconds depending on zone
[*] Fixed bonus health from cave buff not being calculated when buying Greed (Wizard's exclusive item)
[*] Fixed player losing levels when entering second loop portal while above lvl 12
[*] Some other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update (V1.038)
notes.notes:
Wasn't really planning on making any major updates, but i felt like game was lacking those juicy rare items. Once you have beaten zone boss there is now small chance to find arena items from shop. Completing arenas will increase your changes to find these items. This would also make completing arenas feel more worthwhile since there would be permanent benefit. Also this might encourage players to try items they would usually ignore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295019/fa27ebcd6e172b3cb59da5935babba4e2214b5c0.png[/img]

[list]
[*]There is now small chance to get arena items from shop
[*]Fixed Loot Box not working with new bosses (Pirate's exclusive item)
[*]Fixed grammar mistake in opening story 
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update (V1.037)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed sawblade sprite in logbook
[*]Fixed factory arena boss having wrong sprite
[*]Fixed rats being unable to climb walls while frozen
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update (v1.036)
notes.notes:
Some of the new items were feeling bit underwhelming, so i tried to do some rebalancing. Burn damage from fire weapons was also feeling really weak during later levels, so i did small rework for burn damage. Painfully long animations are finally shortened. This had been on my todo-list for very long time, but for some reason it always slipped my mind.


[list]
[*] Reduced ninja mask cooldown from 5 to 4 seconds
[*] Magic spheres now gain up to +50% attack distance after few seconds (Making them bit more useful against flying enemies)
[*] Frost hammer's bonus damage is calculated after frost status is applied (First hit now also deals bonus damage)
[*] Magic staff now has new possible stat for spinning speed (maximum +100%)
[*] Frost thrower and Iciclegun now deal up to 25% bonus damage based on frost status
[*] Iciclegun base damage reduced from 4 to 3.5
[*] Increased travel speed of sawblades
[*] Afterburn damage from fire weapons in now increased up to 100% when maximum burn duration is exceeded (Flamethrower, Flaregun & Dragon Launcher)
[*] Reduced duration of opening and ending animations
[*] Fixed yeti boss and penguin boss dealing collision damage if their jump attack got interrupted (They are only supposed to deal collision damage during jump attack)
[*] Reduced frost thrower hit sound
[*] Fixed Frost thrower appearing as spidergun in end stats
[*] Fixed magic staff special ammo consumption being too low
[*] Fixed police not having guaranteed fruit drop from spider boss & dragon boss
[/list]

notes.title: Struggle Continues!
notes.notes:
Long waited update is finally here! 

[previewyoutube=EQzljPtRl5w;full][/previewyoutube]

Whats new?
[list]
[*] 3 new zones
[*] 3 new characters
[*] 9 new weapons
[*] 26 new items
[*] 16 new achievements
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295019/c8d990a175b25ab570170889ac04dbdac00b045f.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295019/b5b69e6ad56524cc3b7496655565810d81374f96.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295019/ee63b49727ddb983bb1f6675dbe18a6365759d6e.png[/img]

There is now 1 unique item for each character to further differentiate their playstyles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295019/ef4c84f593d490be8dce041a8d0436e76811b52d.png[/img]
New item 'Champions Belt' will increase chance for arenas to appear. New arenas are probably going to be hard for most players, but this should help lot if you are going for 100% completion. Note: you will have to complete atleast 1 arena before this can appear on shop.


Some changes and fixes for old content:

Changes:
[list]
[*] Increased miner's bomb damage scaling up to 15%
[*] Increased shocking lasso damage by 12%
[*] Increased cave buff bonus health from +15% to +20%
[*] Ratman's flamethrower damage reduced from 2 to 1. Flames now ignite player dealing 5 damage over time. 
[*] Time limit for unlocking time mod increased from 7 to 8 minutes
[*] Completing arena now unlocks arena buff for logbook even if you choose weapon as reward
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Items in UI now appear on second row when there is more than 16 items (items would sometimes go out of screen)
[*] Items in end screens & records now scale if there is too many of them 
[*] Fixed super ability flashbang sometimes bouncing to wrong direction
[*] Fixed parrot sometimes attacking more enemies than intended
[*] Fixed parrot sometimes not targeting small flies when it killed big fly
[*] Fixed "Reinforcements have arrived!" text not appearing with some languages
[*] Fixed potential error with bow
[*] Some other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Small update (v1.034)
notes.notes:
Looks like achievements stopped working after i updated to latest version of GameMaker Studio. I have now updated to latest version of Steamworks SDK and steamworks extension so they should be working again.

-Fixed steam achievements not working

notes.title: Small update (v1.033)
notes.notes:
After some consideration i decided to tune down some of the harder challenges. Difficulty of fly curse and later arenas should be now more reasonable. Spring gloves are getting small nerf. Bonus melee range ended up feeling bit ridiculous with sheriff's recent buffs. Helicopters have felt like paper considering their massive hitbox, so they are receiving bit more health.


-Number of flies from fly curse reduced from 3 to 2
-Maximum number of enemies in sewer arena reduced from 4 to 3 
-Maximum number of enemies in city arena reduced from 4 to 3 
-Spring gloves bonus range reduced from 30% to 25% 
-Helicopter health increased from 40 to 45
-Fixed hunter's bonus damage not being applied to heavy bomber
-Fixed some ending messages not showing up when using metro

notes.title: Small update (v1.032)
notes.notes:
There is now 1 item reroll after using metro, so player can now get some upgrades instantly. Still working on that bigger update, but since most important hint message wasn't showing up properly i had to make quick update.

-Added 1 reroll for shop after using metro 
-Fixed "Did you know that melee attacks can deflect bullets?" not being fully displayed in speech bubble
-Reduced time for first picture of ending animation

notes.title: Price permanently reduced!
notes.notes:
[b]Price of The Struggle of Combat is permanently reduced from $7.99 > $4.99[/b]

There had been price differential between Itch.io version and Steam version. This felt unfair for Steam users, so i have decided to reduce price of The Struggle of Combat. Also lot of other similar games have been selling for cheaper, so i thought this might be more fair price. Price might go up for some currencies, since recommended prices have also changed.


New update is still in progress, but i have done most of the work for new zones, so it shouldn't take too long. Currently working on new mini bosses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295019/b809f13447253532f9a13126f0b7e16d450c7303.gif[/img]

notes.title: Achievement update (v1.031)
notes.notes:
I felt like there was huge gap between "mid tier" achievements and later achievements, so i added achievements for beating game with each character and completing arenas. If you have already completed these challenges, you should get these achievements just by walking out of prison area.


-16 new achievements added
-Some of the old achievement icons reworked
-Added new ability icon for super slash (Second part of grappling hook)
-Item drops that spawn inside side walls now move torwards center (Items would end up floating up the walls so players couldnt reach them)

*Hotfix:
-Fixed incorrect treasure chest description
-Fixed prison shop not having guaranteed weapon during loops
-Fixed mutants sometimes getting stuck jumping

notes.title: Character update (v1.030)
notes.notes:
Some of the character bonuses felt bit insignificant, so i decided to give small buff for most of them. This should make each character feel more unique. Also small changes for some of the abilities. Initially i only meant to fix few bugs, but i didn't feel like adding update without any gameplay changes.

[b]Character changes:[/b]
-Increased police's coffee drop chance from 25% to 35%
-Increased sheriff's melee range from +15% to +20%
-Reduced miners's bomb cooldown from 15s to 13s
-Increased hunter's maximum focus damage from +15% to +20%
-Increased pirate's special weapon drop chance from +10% to +20% (Bosses no longer double chances)
-Increased ninja's movement speed from +10% to +15%
-Grappling hook's cooldown now starts after using super slash (Super slash now has to be used within 5 seconds)
-Increased soldier's bonus health from +20 to +25
-Reduced cyborg's barrier cooldown from 15s to 13s
-Barrier cooldown now starts after barrier effect ends
-Increased barrier duration from 3s to 4s (It already said 4 seconds in description, but that was mistake)

[b]Other changes & bug fixes:[/b]
-Weapons are now more likely to appear in shops during loops (Often you would only get ammo packs. Now there is guaranteed to be at least 1 weapon)
-Added impact effect when deflecting melee attacks
-Fixed bombs sometimes glitching through walls
-Fixed potential freeze with bombs
-Fixed ninja's super slash not deflecting ninja bosses super slash
-Fixed some enemies getting stuck when far away from player
-Jumping enemies will no longer interrupt their jump attack when player gets far away
-Mechas will no longer attempt to jump over high walls unless player is far away
-Fixed rockman boss & vampyrusman not providing light when burning
-Fixed completion times missing 0 in front of seconds and minutes when they were below 10
-Fixed laser not having clash sound when hitting enemy barrier

notes.title: Small update (v1.029)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295019/73d8c950ff25dea24e8729fa65be352af0dde825.png[/img]

Very shocking small update! Finally fixed some things that had been bothering me for a while.
Shocking laser and flamethrower felt bit underwhelming compared to other explosive weapons. Now their special effects are also applied with shocking effect.


-Shocking laser and ufo launcher now applies 50% of damage amplification to enemies hit by shocking effect
-Shocking flamethrower not applies full burn duration to enemies hit by shocking effect
-Fixed laser's damage amplification being applied to railgun
-Increased soldier boss grenade damage from 10 to 15
-All explosion effects now appear in front of enemies
-Added light to impact effect
-Added light to special weapons and cursed keys
-"Cursed key have been dropped!" is no longer displayed in speech bubble when curse mod is active
-Fixed shocking flamethrower briefly displayed as explosive flamethrower when exiting level
-Fixed 4th loop being briefly displayed as 5th when entering teleporter
-Some other small fixes

notes.title: Small update (v1.028)
notes.notes:
Turns out that mouse lock was causing problems with some accessibility softwares, so i added option to disable mouse lock.

-Added mouse lock option to graphics options
-Fixed Ninja's piercing slash extending further than intended (Super ability)

notes.title: Small update (v1.027)
notes.notes:
Figured that i should start using proper version numbers. (Counting all updates since releasing on itch.io)
After doing some further testing with gamepad, i found out that i often ended up accidentally turning while trying to aim up or down, so i slightly increased axis value required for turning.

-adjusted aiming with gamepad
-fixed "Press 'A' to reroll" text not being visible with some languages
-fixed possible freeze with rats (was really rare)
-fixed cyborg's shield amount

notes.title: Controller Update
notes.notes:
Controller support is finally here! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295019/cd4dc2147714899e191bebeb33dbbf1358a27d33.png[/img]

There is 2 aim modes available. Free aim mode that works similiar to mouse and locked mode where crosshair spins around player at fixed distance. Aim speed can be changed from control options to suit you preference. Selecting shop items will work slightly differently to keyboard controls. Instead of hovering with mouse, description will open soon as you stand under it.

Game wasn't originally planned for gamepad controls, so there are some things that might not work perfectly. Some things will require using free aim mode, such as selecting difficulty switches or opening weapon description.


-Added Gamepad controls
-Added Keyboard & Gamepad tabs to control options
-Fixed incorrect information in bullet upgrade descriptions
-Fixed watergun having more ammo than intended in first clip
-Fixed "Language" text in language options not being visible with some languages selected


[b]Note: If controller is not responding, you may have to disable controller from Steam's Big Picture Mode
Big Picture Mode > Controller Settings > disable configuration support for you controller[/b]

notes.title: Localisation Update 3
notes.notes:
Translations for Japanese, Korean & Chinese are now available! It might take slighty longer to load game since it has to create new fonts. There might be some graphical imperfections with some of line breaks, since there wasnt enough spaces in Japanese and Chinese texts.  Should be fine for most part, but i might have missed few translations.

-Added translations for Japanese, Korean & Chinese (Simplified & Traditional)
-Reverted font changes from previous update (Now they will only apply for Russian translations)

notes.title: Localisation Update 2
notes.notes:
Translations for Portuguese, German, Italian & Russian are now available! There is going to be some minor graphical imperfections, since some of the translations didn't fit properly into menus.

-Added translation for Portuguese, German, Italian & Russian
-Changed some font styles
-Fixed there being extra selection in options menu (when using arrow keys)
-Fixed some translation mistakes


If anyone is interested improving translations, locale file is here:  
[b]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\The Struggle of Combat\locale[/b]
If you modify locale file, just remember to save it as CSV-file and use UTF-8 formatting or some of the letters might not work. Also remember to close locale file before opening the game.

notes.title: Localisation Update
notes.notes:
Started working on localisations for different languages. This update took a while to make since i had to re-code most of the text in game and create localisation file. Note: These translations are made with google translator so i cant quarantee their quality. Let me know you are interested of helping me with these translations. I will be adding more languages in future.

[list]
[*]Added Language options
[*]Added Localisations for French and Spanish
[*]Item descriptions now scale based on text width
[*]Fixed prison music not stopping after using metro (if you went to audio options while in shop area)
[*]Fixed 'Press "E" to enter' not being visible in metro station
[*]Some other small fixes
[/list]
